canonical_baseline: V2 TRAIN_COLLECTION + D1 TRAIN-only rows, because prior support analyses and thresholds were defined versus V2+D1 current support

classification_rule.WULVER_DEV_SUPPORT_NO_GO: target-free expansion does not materially move DEV support
classification_rule.WULVER_DEV_SUPPORT_PARTIAL_SIGNAL: meaningful movement but at least one formal threshold fails
classification_rule.WULVER_DEV_SUPPORT_SOFTWARE_FAILURE: artifact, schema, checksum, or monotonic-distance invariant failure prevents valid evaluation

distance_definition: Euclidean distance in baseline-standardized feature space; nearest neighbor distance is min distance to support set
expanded_support: canonical baseline plus deterministically deduplicated unique Wulver candidate states by oracle_state_fingerprint_v2

feature_schema.TASK_RELEVANT_SUBSPACE: frozen task-relevant subset from config-state surrogate, intersected with available columns

group_improvement_definition: strictly lower group mean NN distance after expansion by >1e-12 and at least one row in the group strictly closer; frozen here because no prior numeric definition was found
local_5nn_density_definition: historical proxy: mean distance to the k=min(5,n_support) nearest support rows; improvement is percent reduction in mean local_5nn distance
purpose: one frozen DEV support evaluation of target-free Wulver sweep; DEV is a fixed evaluation target only
scaler_reference_population: baseline support only; per-feature mean/std from baseline support, std<1e-12 replaced with 1.0; missing/non-numeric filled as 0.0, matching historical standardized_nn_metrics
top_gap_overlap_definition: p10-p90 interval width overlap with DEV interval divided by DEV p10-p90 width; feature improves if expanded overlap > baseline overlap + 1e-12
